title: US Census TIGERweb (current vintage) WMS
note: US administrative and statistical geography from the Census Bureau: states, counties, tracts, block groups, places, legislative districts, urban areas. ArcGIS Server, so layers are named by number and the title carries the meaning; it also rejects GetMap without an explicit STYLES parameter, and answers GetCapabilities only when 'request' precedes 'version'. No WFS: the service reports supportedExtensions WMSServer only, and offers ArcGIS REST /query instead.
